commits.summary: Capture shared Java startup state before entry (verification pending)
commits.body:
A separately scoped native check can initialize a root on the subject JVM before entry and capture the static state of every application class initialized with it in one object table. Class hashes, transitive fields, aliases and eager timing qualify the state. Opaque reads, absent supertypes and overlapping independent captures stop the check. The original single-class scope still compares startup against independent JVMs. Candidate JVM replays apply the same requested initialization and process settings.

Physical JVM and native regression tests checked the cross-class array mutation and the difference made by writing a static after startup. Negative controls exercised opaque reads, overlap, malformed references and changes to the state digest. All 47 changed test groups passed, the inventory lint passed and example 355 replayed both revisions across all 21 inputs. A capped probe on the original fixed Avro converter passed the shared Accessor registration and reached Schema.SCHEMA_RESERVED. Job 20261121-125740-check-avro-converter-after-joint-schema repeats the separately registered full claim on the pinned 124-entry classpath.
